booth.tapToShoot: Tap the round button to take a photo

slideshow.empty: 📸 The slideshow starts with the first photo
slideshow.tapFullscreen: Tap the screen to go full screen

admin.liveHint: Live view only runs during the countdown, 10 s at most (on a DSLR, the shutter stays open during live view).
admin.mirrorHint: Live view is flipped like a selfie. Saved photos are never flipped.
admin.languageHint: Language of the tablet, the slideshow and this page.
admin.focusAutoClose: This box closes by itself as soon as the camera detects the change.
admin.focusUnknown: Unknown focus mode: check that the camera is connected.
admin.connectHint: Scan this QR code with the tablet's camera, or type the address below into its browser.
admin.qrAlt: QR code of the Flash & Furious address
admin.themeHint: Tablet colours (background, preview area…). Changes apply to the tablet immediately.
admin.decoHint: Also adds the theme drawings (pumpkins, fir trees, cake…) to the photos, on top of the chosen frame.
admin.decoNone: The “{theme}” theme has no decorations: no effect.
admin.decoNoFrame: Choose a frame below so the decorations are added.
admin.frameTextHint: The same text for every frame. Today's date is added automatically on frames that show it.
admin.framesHint: Add your own frames (transparent PNG or SVG, 3:2 ratio) to the project's frames/ folder.

shoot.busy: A photo is already in progress.
shoot.noJpeg: Photo saved, but without a JPEG (camera set to RAW only): no preview possible.
shoot.noFiles: The camera did not return any file.
shoot.retouchFailed: The photo could not be edited: it was saved as is.

camera.notDetected: No camera detected. Check the USB cable and that the camera is switched on.
camera.claimed: The camera is already used by another program (often the desktop automount, gvfs). See the README.
camera.focusOrBusy: The camera could not focus or is busy. Try again.
camera.timeout: The camera is not responding (timed out).
camera.liveUnavailable: Live view unavailable: check that the camera is in a shooting mode that allows live view.
camera.focusFailed: The camera did not take the photo (could not focus?). Add some light or move a little closer, then try again.
camera.noFile: The camera did not take the photo. Try again.
camera.focusModeHint: This camera's focus mode cannot be read.
camera.autofocusUnsupported: This camera cannot be focused remotely.
camera.unresponsive: The camera is plugged in but not responding (asleep?). Wake it up, or switch it off and on again.

storage.notMounted: Photo storage: the photos folder is not mounted from the host, photos would be lost. Check PHOTOS_PATH.
storage.externalMissing: Photo storage: the external disk is not plugged in or not mounted. Photos are blocked.
storage.notWritable: Photo storage: the photos folder cannot be written (read-only or unplugged disk?). Photos are blocked.

canon-eos-1000d.liveUnavailable: Live view unavailable: set the camera's mode dial to P, Av, Tv or M and enable “Live View shooting” in the menu.
canon-eos-1000d.focusFailed: The camera could not focus, so no photo was taken. Add some light or move a little closer, then try again.
canon-eos-1000d.focusModeHint: The actual mode is read from the camera. It is changed with the AF/MF switch on the lens.
toManualSteps: Have someone stand where people will pose.
On the camera, half-press the shutter button (without pressing it fully) until it beeps: focus is set.
Without touching the focus ring, set the lens AF/MF switch to MF.
toAutoSteps: On the lens, set the AF/MF switch to AF.
canon-eos-1000d.focusDone: Focus done! Now switch the lens to MF.
canon-eos-1000d.unresponsive: The camera is not responding (asleep?). Half-press its shutter button to wake it up, or switch it off and on again.
